correctness.rationale: Every rank-one matrix is x y^T modulo a free F_q^× scaling. Upper triangularity is exactly max supp(x) <= min supp(y), and U^T G U=0 is exactly x^T G x=0. Counting y by its first nonzero coordinate reduces the problem to prefix quadratic zero counts; summation by parts and the standard odd-field zero formula give the displayed expression. Exhaustive enumeration independently gives 44 and 80 for the two F_3 examples.

value.rationale: The source explicitly identifies twisted zero fibers as an open extension. The rank-one stratum is the first nontrivial part of the requested rank distribution, and the exact formula reveals which flag-relative invariants enter. More importantly, the 44/80 permutation-congruent pair proves that global Witt type alone cannot control the triangular recurrence, a structural boundary that changes how the open problem must be formulated.
